journeys.title: Find your way around the working surface

steps.title: Orient in the relation outline
steps.say: Choose Relation outline. It shows the same objects as the map; changing representation edits nothing.

steps.title: Inspect an object without leaving your task
steps.say: Select an object. Open focused object reads it; the current editor stays available. Comparison is visual.

steps.title: Open the full reading or editor
steps.say: Open focused object. Inspect before including a source window. Back returns here; cues record navigation only.

steps.title: Open the manuscript
steps.say: Choose Writing or Continue writing on Home. The status distinguishes saved text from its PDF.

steps.title: See where you are
steps.say: Open Document outline under Writing. Choose a heading to move there.

steps.title: Read the plan for the reader
steps.say: Under More, open Reader plan. Its source mark shows whether a section is linked.

steps.title: Go to a section in the manuscript
steps.say: Select a section and Open in manuscript. Use Back to Reader plan to return.

steps.title: Return where you were
steps.say: Use Back to Reader plan. Your place and any unsaved draft are kept.

steps.title: Inspect one change
steps.say: Under More, choose Activity. Open an entry to inspect its changes and saved text.

steps.title: Find what is blocking work
steps.say: Choose Tasks and open a blocked task. Read its blocker and next action.

steps.title: Keep the selected Work in view
steps.say: Leave Tasks. The task chip returns to this task; Clear removes that context.

steps.title: See what a message will carry
steps.say: Open Conversation, then Options and Context. Check the retained target and reading; Next message sets future preferences.

steps.title: Preview a template without saving
steps.say: In Writing, open Document setup and Template & layout. Preview is separate from Apply this reviewed preview.

steps.title: Open Work
steps.say: Choose Tasks to read their standing.

steps.title: Select a waiting item
steps.say: Open a blocked task to read its blocker and next action.

steps.title: Keep it in view
steps.say: Open another view. The task chip returns to the selected task.

journeys.title: From the reader plan to the source and back

steps.title: Open the reader plan
steps.say: Under More, open Reader plan and choose a source-linked section.

steps.title: Go to the section's source
steps.say: Select a bound section, then Open in manuscript. A Back control appears at the top for the return.

steps.title: Return to the plan
steps.say: Use Back to Reader plan. The selected section and any unsaved draft are kept.

journeys.title: Find your place in the manuscript

steps.title: Open the manuscript
steps.say: Choose Writing. The status distinguishes saved text from the PDF.

steps.title: Use the outline
steps.say: Open Document outline under Writing. Choose a heading to move there.

steps.title: See the document setup
steps.say: Open Document setup, then Template & layout. Preview makes a candidate; nothing changes until Apply this reviewed preview.

steps.title: Open Activity
steps.say: Choose Activity. Changes are grouped by day; the category selector is the owner's filter.

steps.title: Open an entry
steps.say: Open an entry. Its hunks come first; whole saved text stays behind Show saved text; Open goes to the affected object.

steps.title: Open your document list
steps.say: Choose Sources. Add local document accepts PDF or text. Check its destination, then inspect the offered reading.

steps.title: Find the conversation
steps.say: After inspecting document text, Use in conversation selects that reading and keeps your question. Send is separate.

steps.title: Check the reading for your question
steps.say: Inspect Next message context. PDF text does not show figure or equation layout; inspect the original page when needed.

steps.title: Open Research for references
steps.say: Under More, open Research and Literature. Add to Literature records provenance; Link to claim needs a passage and rationale.

journeys.title: See what a message will carry

steps.title: Open the conversation
steps.say: Open Conversation. Its composer names the message target.

steps.title: Inspect the context
steps.say: Open Next message context to inspect the reading, target and AI settings.
